title: No code-level guard rejects a mainnet address
expected: pay and request refuse any address that is not a testnet address.
observed: The ZIP 321 layer accepted mainnet Sapling (zs1) and regtest addresses, and the raw pay --to path checked nothing. Fixed: both are refused.
closure: Closed by failing tests first, then assertTestnetAddress in src/zip321.js and a check in bin/murmur.js.

title: No real radio test between two physical devices
expected: A laptop-and-phone run over a real link is retained under evidence/.
observed: Runs B and C are loopback on one machine.
closure: The owner runs the procedure and saves the output as a new evidence directory.

title: Multi-hop is simulated only
expected: A real relay through a third device.
observed: Only two physical devices were available.
closure: Run with three devices once available.

title: The devtool PCZT path cannot sign internal-scope change notes
expected: A payer can make a second offline payment from the same account.
observed: WrongFvkForNote on a spend of a change note; Run C paid from a separate account.
closure: In devtool prove and sign, pick the scope whose address matches each spend's recipient. Needs the pczt crate to expose the spend recipient and a devtool rebuild (dependency sources must be re-fetched).

title: The memo in a payment request was not observed on chain
expected: The merchant's wallet shows the memo from the request.
observed: Neither wallet's view of Run C shows a memo; a native-send memo displays fine.
closure: Build a PCZT with a memo, decrypt the output with the recipient's viewing key, and find where it is lost or not displayed.

title: Whether an offline transaction can carry a later expiry is not verified
expected: A known way to extend validity beyond about 50 minutes, or a documented hard limit.
observed: The default expiry is 120 blocks since NU7; overriding it offline was not tried.
closure: Check ZIP 203 and the devtool for an expiry override and test it.

title: No Bluetooth or other radio transport
observed: Transport is UDP over an existing link.
closure: A native app would be required; out of scope.

title: Double-spend before broadcast is bounded, not prevented
observed: The spend policy caps exposure only.
closure: Stated as a limit everywhere; not solvable without a ledger.

title: The judge page has not been checked on real devices by the owner
expected: Checked on a real laptop and phone.
observed: Checked in a headless browser at desktop and phone width.
closure: The owner opens the deployed page on a laptop and a phone.

title: The sealed-box construction has not been independently audited
observed: Built from node:crypto primitives; reviewed by the authors only.
closure: Stated everywhere; an audit is out of scope.

title: No test asserts that the bridge never reads a key file
expected: A test fails if the bridge reads the identity file's contents.
observed: Reviewed by hand: the file path is passed as an argument only.
closure: Add a stub test with an unreadable identity file path.

title: No public block-explorer confirmation of the transactions
expected: A public testnet explorer link for each transaction id.
observed: Testnet explorers returned 403 or did not resolve from this machine. The owner pasted a 'Transaction Not Found' page from an explorer whose footer says 'Mainnet'; which network that explorer was on is unknown. The chain-server read-back works.
closure: Get the exact URL the owner used (the host decides the network). A second chain server was tried: YWallet does not serve testnet, and 'inspect -l' has no server option. Add explorer links only if one is verified.
